Description - GET /{accountName}/{folderName}/{subfolderName}

Public web page of a folder: http://chomikuj.pl followed by the folder path, i.e. the same string as the folder's DownloadFolder/globalId (/<account>/<folder>/<subfolder>; Observed for the captured folders). The client does not request these pages itself (they are not among its web URL templates); they were fetched anonymously (no session, no cookie) in the live follow-up to look for a visible effect of ModifyFolder description, freePoints and freeTransfer. Observed: HTTP 200, and none of the three fields appears: neither the description marker nor any free-transfer or points wording (word counts in the meta files, equal before and after the change). Only status and headers were recorded; the body digest is kept in each capture.

Path template. OAS path templates cannot span a variable number of segments, so the template shows the depth used in the captures (a folder two levels below the account root); other depths follow the same globalId pattern.
